name: Security Scan

# Runs on every push / PR to catch injected malicious code, secret leaks and
# vulnerable dependencies before they can reach the site.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, genspark_ai_developer]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, genspark_ai_developer]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 1' # weekly Monday 03:00 UTC

permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write

jobs:
  # ---- CodeQL static analysis (detects code injection / XSS patterns) ----
  codeql:
    name: CodeQL Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: javascript
      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3

  # ---- Dependency vulnerability audit ----
  audit:
    name: npm audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts || npm install --ignore-scripts
      - name: Audit production dependencies
        run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high || true

  # ---- Secret / ad-injection guard ----
  guard:
    name: Injection & Secret Guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Fail on hard-coded secrets or ad/script injection in source
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "Scanning source for injected third-party scripts / iframes / ad markup..."
          # Look ONLY in application source (not node_modules) for suspicious
          # third-party script/iframe tags or known ad-network domains.
          if grep -rniE '<iframe|<script[^>]+src=["'"'"']?https?://|googlesyndication|doubleclick|adservice|popads|propeller|onclickads' \
               public src 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'sanitize'; then
            echo "::error::Suspicious third-party script/iframe/ad markup found in source."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Scanning for committed secrets..."
          if grep -rniE '(JWT_SECRET|PASSWORD|SECRET|API_KEY)\s*=\s*["'"'"'][^"'"'"']{8,}' \
               --include='*.js' --include='*.json' src 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::Possible committed secret found."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK — no injected ads or committed secrets detected."
